comment: Which copies of the Hermes plugin scanner scripts/web/guard-scan.mjs runs. Each is fetched at the commit named here, so a CI run is reproducible. The gateways run the fork; upstream is scanned as well because the fork tracks it. These are the same two commits the plugin repository pins in .github/scanner-pins.json: the plugin's own guard-scan job is the one that blocks an import, and this one has to say the same thing earlier. Move a pin here in a pull request of its own, at the same time as the plugin's.
